evidence_boundaries: No installed browser capture is exercised.
The production native host AddDownload path remains not_ready.
No packaged Windows update activation adapter is exercised.
This is not a Windows 10/11 supported-OS clean-VM matrix claim.
S180 requirement blockers and v1 release-readiness gates remain unchanged.

stages.name: install
stages.coverage: Built and installed the current-user package in an isolated profile; launched both packaged executables; verified and repaired native-host registration.

stages.name: capture
stages.coverage: Adapter contract only: acknowledged handoff, cancel-after-accept, rejection/offline fallback, timeout, and duplicate suppression. No installed browser is launched.

stages.name: resume
stages.coverage: Production resume path validates remote identity and requests only the missing suffix from a local HTTP fixture.

stages.name: licensed_media
stages.coverage: CC0 progressive, HLS, DASH, subtitle, live-window, hash, duration, and synchronization fixtures.

stages.name: update
stages.coverage: In-process signed staging/activation contracts cover successful activation and forced rollback while preserving paused jobs, queues, offsets, and partials.

stages.name: uninstall
stages.coverage: Existing package smoke verifies both explicit data choices remove app/browser integration while preserving completed downloads.
